item.title: Windows 11 Is Collecting Data on Which Coding Agents and Developer Tools You Use
item.description:
📝 That led from a handful of string comparisons to a running Windows component that records which coding agents and developer tools have been used, saves that information locally, and reports it to Windows Diagnostics. These were explicit executable names embedded in a Windows component: Following the references showed that the names were used in comparisons. A regular Windows codex.
🔗 Read more: https://xusheng.dev/posts/windows-coding-agent-telemetry/

item.title: Why 3dfx 1 cards had such a washed out color output?
item.description:
📝 NeXT and 3DFX were much closer to linear than other contemporary displays. They did this intentionally. If you have 10+ bits per channel like the professional rendering systems, linear displays are The Right Thing.
🔗 Read more: https://twitter.com/id_aa_carmack/status/2122478083319992513

item.title: Tokendoctor – the same Claude Code for up to 38% less
item.description:
📝 Slide /tokendoctor slide on: where Claude Code would summarize, old tool outputs go instead. Undo /tokendoctor undo lists every change tokendoctor made and puts any one back. Install claude plugin marketplace add localixai/tokendoctor claude plugin install tokendoctor@tokendoctor Update with claude plugin marketplace update tokendoctor and claude plugin update tokendoctor@tokendoctor, then restart Claude Code.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/localixai/tokendoctor
